title: Natural comparison between raw derived Hom and restricted cohomology
statement: Let $S$ be any scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $p\in\mathbb N$ and $U\to S$ any etale scheme. There exists a family of additive isomorphisms $e_{h,F}:A(h,F,U,p)\simeq R(h,F,U,p)$ for every $h:Y\to S$ and every abelian etale sheaf $F$, where $A$ is the raw derived-Hom group of [lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison] and $R$ is [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology]. For every triangle $a:Y'\to Y$, $h'=ah$ and coefficient map $\phi:a^{-1}F\to F'$, the canonical restricted-cohomology map carries $e_{h,F}(t)$ to $e_{h',F'}$ of the explicit raw pullback of $t$, for every raw class $t$. No affine, qcqs, directed-system or limit hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Identify the inverse image of the free abelian represented sheaf of U with the free sheaf of U times_S Y by the sheafification and sections adjunctions and inverse-image composition. The free sheaf corepresents sections on this etale Y-scheme.

Restriction to the etale scheme preserves injectives: its left adjoint is extension by zero, whose stalk is the direct sum over lifts of the geometric point. Direct sums are exact and geometric stalks detect exactness. Apply the sections adjunction to a bounded-below injective resolution, computing derived Hom from the single free sheaf as cohomology of restricted sections. Full faithfulness of D+ into D identifies this with R and yields additive isomorphisms e. The same argument includes p=0 and the empty scheme.

For a triangle over S, its pullback projection equation is r prime followed by a equals q followed by r. The two inverse-image composition comparisons give exactly rawAffineRestrictedCoefficient. Naturality of the derived adjunction unit, its triangle identities, the single-functor comparison and the shift comparison identify the raw pullback factors with P followed by this coefficient map. Applying homology gives the displayed naturality equation uniformly for all h, F, a and phi.
